name: settleview_venue_dropped

query_condition.sql: SELECT settleview_component, sum(inc) AS n FROM (SELECT settleview_component, max(value) - CASE WHEN min(CAST(start_time AS BIGINT)) >= min(_timestamp) * 1000 - 90000000000 THEN 0 ELSE min(value) END AS inc FROM "settleview_venue_dropped" WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY settleview_component, __hash__, start_time) GROUP BY settleview_component HAVING sum(inc) >= 1

description: Venue data dropped by a full buffer.
